name: Lost Kin
source:
Lobo knows his best friend Badger better than ANYONE; of course he noticed the day something changed in him.

After a year of searching, he finally found him: the impostor who had taken over Badger’s life.

And unless that at tea it returns to Lobo his friend, the gun’s going off. 

[From [url=https://grimrose-studios.itch.io/lost-kin]Itch.io[/url]]
